name: RippleGate
description: Evidence-led API compatibility and release impact analysis
implemented_features: bounded OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 diff with versioned rule engine
registered consumer dependency graph with honest coverage
controlled consumer test execution (allowlisted suites, real Node assertions)
deterministic BLOCK/REVIEW/PASS policy with immutable evidence
FastAPI REST surface with demo sessions and scoped authorization
GitHub webhook HMAC validation and deduplication
Next.js dashboard with evidence ladder, diff viewer, dependency graph
GitHub Actions CI workflow (python-quality, fixture-contracts, web-quality, source-policy)
Docker Compose local deployment and operational scripts
planned_features: GitHub App Checks API mode (APP_MODE_UNCONFIGURED without credentials)
known_limitations: bounded OpenAPI/SQL subsets; unsupported constructs reported UNKNOWN
demo sessions are not production identity
public deployment not verified (no authorized host)
Docker Compose path documented but not executed in the build sandbox (no Docker daemon); stack verified directly on Python/Node with PostgreSQL 16.4
only registered consumers mapped; unsupported OpenAPI/SQL constructs reported UNKNOWN
GitHub App mode unconfigured (APP_MODE_UNCONFIGURED without installation credentials)
public hosted deployment not attempted (no authorized host)

ci_verification.method: Final-SHA CI observation is recorded in docs/RELEASE_RECOVERY.md and in the release report generated after the final commit; this file intentionally carries no self-referential SHA claim.

verification_statuses.ci_on_pushed_main: see docs/RELEASE_RECOVERY.md for the exact-SHA run record
